evidence.quote: In September, we took the added step of stating that we will continue actions to put downward pressure on longer-term interest rates until the outlook for the job market improves substantially in a context of price stability.
My colleagues and I have been and remain quite concerned about the stubbornly high level of unemployment--particularly long-term unemployment.
overly tight lending standards may now be preventing creditworthy borrowers from buying homes, thereby slowing the revival in housing and impeding the economic recovery.
we will continue to use the policy tools that we have to help support economic recovery.
To be sure, the housing sector is far from being out of the woods.
